intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in our database opened in {{year}}, but they are not in the same city. This page compares recorded fees and flags a placement record that may not be a confirmed M.Com package.
RIMT University vs University Business School for M.Com is a private university in Mandi Gobindgarh compared with a public business school at Panjab University, Chandigarh.

sections.heading: RIMT University vs University Business School for M.Com: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose University Business School, Chandigarh, if you want a public university department, recorded year tuition of ₹41,090, and an entrance exam listed as CET Punjab. The 2023 placement row on this page, at an average of ₹14 lakh and a highest of ₹58 lakh, looks high for M.Com and may belong to a wider UBS / MBA-school report. Confirm the official M.Com report before you use those figures.
Choose RIMT University if you want a recorded year total fee of ₹45,000 for Master of Commerce and a campus in Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab. This page has no RIMT M.Com placement row.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: RIMT University has a recorded Master of Commerce total fee of ₹45,000 a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed two-year total, until you check the official circular.
University Business School has recorded M.Com (E-Commerce) tuition of ₹41,090 a year. This is a recorded tuition head, not a confirmed full payable fee. Confirm the official Panjab University notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: UBS has a recorded 2023 row, listed against M.Com (E-Commerce), with an average package of ₹14 lakh and a highest package of ₹58 lakh. Those figures are in the range often quoted for UBS postgraduate management programmes, so this page does not treat them as confirmed M.Com packages.
RIMT University has no M.Com placement row on this page. Ask the university for its latest official postgraduate report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: University Business School has CET Punjab listed in our records on this page. Confirm the current official admissions notice for the exact test and eligibility.
RIMT University has no entrance exam listed here. Read the official M.Com admissions page for any university test or merit process.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: RIMT University is listed at Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab, on the Ambala-Ludhiana highway, not in Chandigarh city.
University Business School is listed at Arts Block III, Panjab University, Sector 14, Chandigarh. This is a same-course comparison across two different cities.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a public department on the Panjab University campus, University Business School is the side in Chandigarh, with recorded tuition of ₹41,090 a year. Do not use the 2023 ₹14 lakh / ₹58 lakh row as a confirmed M.Com package until the official report says so.
If you want a recorded year total fee of ₹45,000 and are open to Mandi Gobindgarh, RIMT University is the side we can quote on fees, but you must ask for a placement report.
Do not invent a missing package or treat an unconfirmed row as official M.Com data.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, RIMT University or University Business School, for M.Com?
faqs.answer: RIMT University, in Mandi Gobindgarh, has a recorded year total fee of ₹45,000 and no placement row here. UBS Chandigarh is a public department with recorded tuition of ₹41,090 a year; its 2023 row of a ₹14 lakh average and a ₹58 lakh highest package is not treated here as a confirmed M.Com report.

faqs.question: Is RIMT University in Chandigarh?
faqs.answer: No. Our records list RIMT University at Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab. University Business School is at Panjab University, Sector 14, Chandigarh.

faqs.question: What fees are listed for these M.Com programmes?
faqs.answer: RIMT University has a recorded year total fee of ₹45,000. UBS has recorded tuition of ₹41,090 a year. Confirm both official circulars, including other payable heads.

faqs.question: Can I use the UBS 2023 packages of ₹14 lakh and ₹58 lakh for M.Com?
faqs.answer: Not without the official M.Com report. This page flags that those figures may belong to a wider UBS or MBA-school report.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is listed?
faqs.answer: CET Punjab is listed for University Business School. RIMT University has no exam listed on this page. Check each official admissions notice.
